name: KOPI
recent: Oriental Kopi 于 2026 年 10 月 20 日完成以 RM23.00 million 现金收购 Puchong 一块租赁土地及工厂单位的交易。近期新闻围绕菜单语言争议与抵制呼声，多家券商表示销售未受影响、门店扩张按计划进行。最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收环比增长 6.4%，但净利同比减少 5.3%。
notable: 完成以 RM23.00 million 现金收购 Puchong 租赁土地及工厂单位。
最新季度营收环比增长 6.4%，净利环比增长 13.1%。
多家券商在菜单语言争议与抵制呼声中表示销售未受影响、门店扩张按计划进行。
risks: 菜单语言争议引发抵制呼声，近期新闻持续关注。
最新季度净利同比减少 5.3%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM156.626 million，环比增长 6.4%，同比增长 34.2%；净利为 RM17.004 million，环比增长 13.1%，同比减少 5.3%；净利率为 10.9%，高于上一季度的 10.2%。

recent_en: Oriental Kopi completed the cash acquisition of a leasehold land and factory unit in Puchong for RM23.00 million on 20 October 2026. Recent news focused on a menu language controversy and boycott calls, with several brokers stating sales were unaffected and store expansion remained on track. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 6.4% QoQ while net profit fell 5.3% YoY.
notable_en: Completed the cash acquisition of a leasehold land and factory unit in Puchong for RM23.00 million.
Latest quarter revenue rose 6.4% QoQ and net profit rose 13.1% QoQ.
Several brokers said sales were unaffected and store expansion remained on track amid the menu language controversy and boycott calls.
risks_en: A menu language controversy has triggered boycott calls, with ongoing news coverage.
Latest quarter net profit fell 5.3% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM156.626 million, up 6.4% QoQ and 34.2% YoY; net profit was RM17.004 million, up 13.1% QoQ but down 5.3% YoY; net margin was 10.9%, higher than 10.2% in the previous quarter.
